The geo-IP provider could be failing on its side. But a 401 that names an invalid API key, arriving right after a key rotation, points to our credential, not a provider outage.

Change the rotation process so the new key is checked before the old one is revoked. Also consider letting enrichment fall back to the geo-cache, or degrade gracefully, so a geo-IP failure doesn't fail ingest.
